Union Bank of India SO Admit Card 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Union Bank of India (UBI) has released the Admit Card for the post of Specialist Officers SO. This recruitment has been issued for 395 posts. The online application process for Union Bank of India SO Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 21 July 2026, to 10 August 2026. The Exam is going to conducted on 06 September 2026. Candidates must download their Union Bank of India SO Admit Card 2026, which are given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 21 July 2026
  • Last Date : 10 August 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 10 August 2026
  • Exam Date : 06 September 2026
  • Admit Card : 31 August 2026

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 1180/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 177/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
